mechanism: Native desktop client and source-bound supervisor of the canonical Studio media job service
source_repository: mlx2 local canonical media development worktree
modifications: No source implementation copied. Original bounded loopback HTTP client maps advertised routes to the existing durable job API. Original supervisor freezes operator-selected canonical mlx2 source through RunnerManager, prepares only media and observability dependencies and launches its fixed media entrypoint. Existing canonical job, artifact, source, isolated-worker and accelerator ownership contracts remain authoritative. No text serving fallback.

public_validation.scope: Source integration and focused synthetic CPU regressions; no model qualification or performance claim.
public_validation.evidence: Focused synthetic test modules distributed with this implementation; private campaign evidence is not distributed.
